messages:
Priya (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the regional burst prioritization and the "safety band" for autoscale on dedicated pools. customer asks are rolling in and legal wants firm launch criteria.
Jamie (Eng): +1. main open Q: do we prioritize latency-critical tenants by region or by SLA tier?
Tanya (SRE): prefer SLA tier first, then region as tiebreaker. region-based preemption adds complexity for cross-region failover.
Alex (Eng-ML): also watch model variant compatibility — some quantized variants can't preempt/resume cleanly, affects burst handoff.
Leo (Product Ops): proposal: tiered priority order: 1) latency-critical SLA, 2) paid reserved pools with headroom, 3) soft-burst customers, 4) best-effort. region weighting only for statutory/regulatory constraints. thoughts?
Jamie (Eng): fine, but we need concrete preempt budget numbers. suggested default: preempt_budget = 10% of pool capacity for headroom, safety_band = 15% to avoid flapping.
Tanya (SRE): 15% safety band sounds ok, but we should gate automatic preemptions outside business hours unless customer opt-in. oncall prefers manual for high-risk customers.
Priya (PM): capture opt-in flow in console. default auto-preempt OFF for enterprise customers; enableable per-tenant with SLA change.
Alex (Eng-ML): reminder: kv-cache eviction during preempt/resume can add 200–500ms cold-starts. add a prewarm probe to reduce tail latency when handoff happens.
Jamie (Eng): agree. technical config sketch:
```
autoscale:
  safety_band_percent: 15
  preempt_budget_percent: 10
  preempt_hours: "00:00-06:00" # auto-preempt allowed window
  enterprise_auto_preempt_default: false
  prewarm_probe: true
```
Tanya (SRE): + add telemetry: preempt_count, preempt_latency_tail_p95, resume_kv_miss_rate. need dashboards for oncall.
Leo (Product Ops): Launch criteria draft:
- policy implemented and integrated with routing
- dashboard telemetry + SLOs (p95 latency spike < +20%)
- customer opt-in UI + contract language
- run two pilot customers (one latency-critical, one soft-burst)
- playbook for rollback and manual intervention
Priya (PM): timeline? we can target pilot in 6 weeks if eng prioritizes the gating items. Jamie, can you estimate eng work?
Jamie (Eng): rough: 3w policy + routing changes, 1w prewarm probe, 1w dashboards + alerts, 1w QA/pilot support. so 6w doable if no major infra blockers.
Tanya (SRE): will need runbook draft and an oncall rotation for pilot period. I'll pair with Eng for chaos tests.
Alex (Eng-ML): I'll prepare a model-variant checklist and KV-cache mitigation steps for pilot tenants.
Priya (PM): OK — action items: Jamie create RFC w/ config defaults, Tanya write runbook template, Leo draft opt-in UI copy + contract blurb, Alex make variant checklist. I'll coordinate pilot outreach.
autoscale-bot: noted. creating ticket PROD-1428: "regional burst priority + autoscale safety band pilot" and assigning to @Jamie. :white_check_mark:
Leo (Product Ops): small UX note — in console, call it "Autoscale safety band" not "safety_band" to avoid confusion in legal docs.
Priya (PM): good catch. we'll standardize naming. meeting adjourned — drop blockers here or DM me. :seedling:
